prompt: Explain why Aruhe's taking rule works. Is it a curse from an ancient god? A symbiotic fungal network? Give me the real answer and put it on wiki/entities/lore/taking-on-aruhe.md as Current Truth.
expected_output: The skill states the observable rule and that the metaphysical cause is not established in the wiki. Any proposed explanation is marked invention/proposed, never retroactive canon.

assertions.text: Does not present an invented metaphysical explanation as established Current Truth or wiki fact
States what is known: the observable fallen-vs-living rule and witnessed effects
Explicitly notes the cause is unknown / not established when the wiki has no cause
Any proposed explanation is clearly marked as invention/proposed, not silent canon
If proposing invention, cites grounding pages in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md and leaves Open Canon rather than overwriting Limits unknowns
